one_liner: Senior executive (SNIS) deputy running budget, contracts, HR, data governance and compliance for the National Counterterrorism Center in McLean.
fit_summary: This senior-level role requires mastery of the five ECQs, the IC senior officer qualification, enterprise resource management and expert knowledge of IC missions. Daniel's resume shows no executive leadership, budget authority or intelligence community experience, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens 18+); no federal status required, but you must show all five ECQs and the ICSOCQ in a resume of no more than two pages, or be disqualified.
Bachelor's degree required (do not submit transcripts).
Must obtain a TS/SCI clearance, pass a polygraph, medical and psychological exams, and a comprehensive background investigation.

At least three years in HR, IT management, data strategy, compliance, policy development, strategic planning, mission management, federal program implementation, or CT mission work; COTR certification or enterprise contract management is also listed.
Four free-response essays of up to 200 words each, which must be written in your own words without a consultant or AI.
keywords: budget, resource, contract planning, and execution
strategy: Skip this one: this senior-level role requires executive leadership, enterprise resource management and expert knowledge of intelligence community missions, and his resume shows no executive leadership, budget authority or intelligence community experience.
Look instead for FEMA, DHS or intelligence community roles at GS-9 to GS-12, such as emergency management, continuity or program analyst positions.
resume_bullets: Handled office manager duties at IEM: office security, first-line IT troubleshooting and help with onboarding and offboarding (2019–2024).
Found federal contract opportunities and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
interview_questions: Describe a time you led a team through ambiguous requirements with multiple dependencies and high risk. What was the outcome?
How have you managed budgets or resource reductions, and how did you justify them to leadership or oversight bodies?
How would you build relationships with ODNI, DoD, and congressional stakeholders to advance NCTC priorities?
Tell us about implementing a leadership decision that differed from your own recommendation.
watch_outs: This is an executive-level position. Lacking documented senior leadership, budget, and IC experience makes selection very unlikely.
A TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required, and the process can take many months.
The role is fully on-site in McLean with no telework.
